verified_facts.text: The Ballantyne is set in the Ballantyne community of South Charlotte.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ballantyne is set in the lovely Ballantyne community of South Charlotte.

verified_facts.text: The Amp and The Bowl at Ballantyne are right at the hotel's doorstep.
verified_facts.excerpt:
The Amp
and
The Bowl at Ballantyne
are right at its doorstep.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are dressed in Frette linens and designed with Hollywood Regency touches such as tufted headboards and brass accents.
verified_facts.excerpt: all of which come dressed in Frette Linens, the rooms are generous in size and designed with a bit of Hollywood Regency glamour: think tufted headboards, brass accents

verified_facts.text: Grand Deluxe rooms overlook the park.
verified_facts.excerpt: choose a Grand Deluxe if you want to overlook the park

verified_facts.text: Many of the hotel's suites have balconies with views of the park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Many of our Charlotte hotel suites near SouthPark Mall feature balconies with views of the park.

verified_facts.text: The Cottage at Ballantyne is a residence on the property.
verified_facts.excerpt: including The Cottage at Ballantyne, a residence on property.

verified_facts.text: The largest occupancy room is the 4 Bedroom Cottage, with a maximum occupancy of 8.
verified_facts.excerpt: The largest occupancy room at The Ballantyne, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Charlotte is the 4 Bedroom Cottage with a maximum occupancy of 8.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers massages, facials, body treatments, nail services and hair salon care.
verified_facts.excerpt: From therapeutic massages & rejuvenating facials to body treatments, nail services & hair salon care

verified_facts.text: The spa has an indoor pool, resistance pools and whirlpool, fitness facilities, a eucalyptus steam room and sauna, a lounge, a boutique and dining.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our spa hotel in Charlotte boasts an indoor pool, resistance pools and whirlpool, fitness facilities, a eucalyptus steam room and sauna, a relaxing lounge, a boutique and dining.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an indoor grotto-inspired pool for year-round swimming.
verified_facts.excerpt: Swim year-round at our hotel in Charlotte at the indoor grotto inspired pool

verified_facts.text: The seasonal outdoor pool has a full pool bar and pool menu, and cabana rentals are available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy enhanced seating options, summer cocktails, exclusive amenities, a full pool bar and a delicious pool menu. Cabana rentals are available

verified_facts.text: Hotel guests get complimentary cruiser bike rental, and the hotel offers transportation to the nearby Greenway trail.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel guests enjoy complimentary cruiser bike rental at The Ballantyne. We offer transportation to nearby Greenway trail

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea is served on weekends with Rare Tea Company blends.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a variety of tea blends from Rare Tea Company, the official tea of the Royal Family. Tea is served each Saturday & Sunday

verified_facts.text: Gallery Restaurant serves Southern American-inspired cuisine, and its dining room has paintings from Awaken Gallery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Southern American-inspired cuisine, offering fine dining at the Gallery Restaurant. Indulge in locally sourced cuisine, succulent steaks with fresh seasonal accompaniments, and desserts. The dining room is outfitted with world-class paintings from Awaken Gallery.

verified_facts.text: Gallery Bar holds one of the largest whiskey collections in the Carolinas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step inside for one of the largest whiskey collections in the Carolinas at Gallery Bar.

verified_facts.text: Dunbar Social by Topgolf Swing Suite has five golf and game simulators with casual fare and craft drinks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Charlotte’s go-to spot for casual fare, craft drinks, and five state-of-the-art golf and game simulators.

verified_facts.text: The Ballantyne has a Clefs d'Or-credentialed concierge.
verified_facts.excerpt:
The Ballantyne is the only hotel with a
Clefs d’Or
–credentialed concierge in North Carolina

verified_facts.text: The hotel opened in 2001 and joined Marriott as a Luxury Collection hotel in 2019.
verified_facts.excerpt: in 2019, when Starwood (which the hotel had been a part of since 2005) and Marriott merged, it joined the Marriott family as a Luxury Collection hotel.

verified_facts.text: Dalmatian statues at the front entrance are a nod to the Bissell family dogs.
verified_facts.excerpt: from the Dalmatian statues at the front entrance (a nod to the Bissell family dogs)

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a large backyard with Adirondack chairs and hammocks.
verified_facts.excerpt: It’s hard to miss the hotel’s massive backyard, but I’d really encourage carving out at least a few minutes to sit in one of the Adirondack chairs or sway in a hammock out there

verified_facts.text: The hotel holds 4 Keys in the Green Key Global Eco-Rating Certification Program.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are proudly in the Green Key Global Eco-Rating Certification Program and have earned 4 Keys.

verified_facts.text: Rooms do not have a fridge or a coffee/tea maker.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, rooms at The Ballantyne, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Charlotte do not have a fridge.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The Ballantyne, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Charlotte.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool is seasonal.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax with a refreshing swim at our hotel in Charlotte, NC, with an indoor pool and seasonal outdoor pool.

verified_facts.text: Stream Park, with walking paths and a playground, is near the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stroll through Stream Park featuring walking paths and a playground.

verified_facts.text: There is no kids club, but the hotel is well set up for families in room options, menus and activities.
verified_facts.excerpt: there’s not a kids club, but the hotel is well set up for families in room options, menus, and activities
